findings.body: T1A explicitly requires a service-bus spec, but this change adds only the service-bus implementation and the circles integration spec. Add a test that exercises handler registration and dispatch through the bus.
findings.title: Not done: service-bus/**/*.spec.ts

findings.body: T1A also explicitly requires a spec under circles/core, but none is added. The integration test covers creation through the API; it does not satisfy this separately named test requirement.

findings.body: JavaScript string length counts UTF-16 code units, so a valid name of 21 emoji is rejected as length 42 even though it contains 21 characters. Count Unicode characters after trimming when enforcing the 40-character limit.
findings.title: Count circle-name characters correctly
